name: How long does it take to improve living room pathway clearance?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to improve living room pathway clearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for improving living room pathway clearance depends on the project's complexity. A simple furniture rearrangement can be completed in a few hours to a day. If the project involves sourcing new furniture, custom built-ins, or minor construction work like removing a non-load-bearing wall, it could take several weeks to a few months, including design, procurement, and installation phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple rearrangement takes hours to a day; complex projects involving new furniture or minor construction can take weeks to months.
